title: AWARE Act of 2024
last_action: Read twice and referred to the Senate Committee on Armed Services.
status: Referred to Senate Armed Services; expired at the end of the 118th Congress
summary: Would have required the Department of Defense to maintain a ledger of covered AI systems and conduct recurring risk assessments addressing dependability, cybersecurity, privacy, bias, escalation, swarm deployment, civilian harm, model updates, and exports to foreign users.
committee_dynamics: The bill proposed a broad accountability framework for military AI, including weapons-related uses, but it was introduced late in the Congress and received no recorded committee action.
advance_rationale: The 118th Congress ended without enactment; the proposal would need reintroduction or incorporation into a later defense vehicle.
verification_level: Bill details and introduced text checked; end-of-Congress status applied.

claim_provenance.note: Inactive status reflects the end of the 118th Congress without enactment.
